entries.name: Acrobatics
entries.description: Keep your footing in a tricky spot or pull off an acrobatic stunt.

entries.name: Animal Handling
entries.description: Calm or train an animal, or get it to behave a certain way.

entries.name: Arcana
entries.description: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.

entries.name: Athletics
entries.description: Jump farther than usual, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.

entries.name: Deception
entries.description: Tell a convincing lie or wear a believable disguise.

entries.name: History
entries.description: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.

entries.name: Insight
entries.description: Read a person's mood and intentions.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries.description: Get what you want by awing or threatening someone.

entries.name: Investigation
entries.description: Dig up obscure information in books or work out how something functions.

entries.name: Medicine
entries.description: Diagnose an illness or work out what killed someone recently dead.

entries.name: Nature
entries.description: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.

entries.name: Perception
entries.description: Notice something easy to miss by using your senses together.

entries.name: Performance
entries.description: Act, tell a story, play music, or dance.

entries.name: Persuasion
entries.description: Convince someone of something honestly and graciously.

entries.name: Religion
entries.description: Recall lore about gods, religious rites, and holy symbols.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.description: Pick a pocket, hide a handheld object, or perform sleight of hand.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.description: Avoid notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.

entries.name: Survival
entries.description: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
